# Contributor Bill of Rights & Responsibilities Welcome to the Alder Stone community. This project is maintained by Nicolae Mihai. ## You have the right to Participate in a harassment-free, open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community. This applies regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation. ## You have the responsibility to Act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community. Treat project discussions as a professional workplace: focus on the code rather than the person; do not use abusive, harassing, threatening, sexualized, or hateful language; and do not publish others' private information without their explicit permission. ## Reporting and enforcement To report a violation or appeal a moderation decision, contact the project maintainer through the repository. Moderation actions may include minimizing or removing content, a warning, a temporary ban, or a permanent ban for repeated or severe violations. Parts of this document are based on the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
